description: Add Contacts to a List - Add multiple contacts to an existing list. Contacts must come from an evidenced import or consent source that the account holder already has (e.g. their own opt-in list, CRM export, or inbound leads) — do not assemble addresses from model knowledge or web scraping. All contact field names use snake_case (e.g. first_name, last_name, email, phone, company_name, job_title, lead_score). Custom snake_case fields are added to the list's columns. The `starred` boolean is a contact setting and is not added as a list column. Contact archiving is handled by archive_contact.

consent_basis.description: REQUIRED attestation of where these contacts came from. The addresses must originate from an evidenced import or consent source the account holder already has — never addresses assembled by the model or scraped from the web. The call is rejected without this value; it is validated by the connector and never sent to the SalesBlink API.

contacts.description: Array of contact objects to add (max 500). All field names must be snake_case; additional custom snake_case fields are allowed.

starred.description: Mark/unmark the contact as starred. This is a contact setting, not a data field/column.

list_id.description: The list ID to add contacts to

remove_duplicates.description: Automatically remove duplicate emails from the list

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID this action applies to. When omitted, the current or default workspace is used.

name: add_contacts

result.description: The raw result returned by the SalesBlink tool.

title: Add Contacts
